column1: # The three supplementary display figures, in manuscript order.

# This file is the sole source for S-numbers. tools/package_supplementary_figures.py (via the final-outputs and supplementary Makefile targets) and tools/write_submission_readme.py all read it, so an S-number changes here only.

# The held-out in-trial AUC figure is not a row here: it is no longer a numbered display item, and its statistics ship instead as the ROC and discrimination sheets of Supplementary Table 7, sourced from figure_data/.

# `source` is relative to final_plots/. S1 is the one supplementary figure that lives directly in final_plots/ rather than final_plots/supplementary/, since it renders alongside the main set but ships as a supplementary item.

# `submission_name` is the filename `make final-outputs` publishes and is recorded verbatim rather than derived from the other columns, since not all entries follow the same naming pattern. The supplementary/ tree separately builds "Supp Figure <number> - <title>.png" from the number and title columns, matching the "Supp Table <number> - <title>.csv" naming used for tables.
